title: Specification
description: A structured representation of a feature specification for a user story or chore work item

workItemId.description: Unique identifier for the subject work item

summary.description: Brief description of the feature/chore and the problem it solves

architecturalSummary.description: High-level description of the approach: affected layers, components, data flow, and how this specification will be satisfied. Reference existing architecture and conventions rather than restating them.

apiContracts.description: Endpoint definitions with OpenAPI-style schemas for requests/responses

databaseSchema.description: Tables/collections, relationships, constraints, and migrations required

uiComponents.description: Components, user interactions, and view/state behaviour required

testingRequirements.description: Testing scenarios and coverage expectations that quality-assurance-engineer must satisfy

tasks.description: Tasks requiring implementation, generally split per technology/programming-language. Each task is handed to a specialised engineer agent.

owner.description: Owner of the task, typically a specialised engineer agent

affectedPaths.description: Paths to projects/folders/files affected by the intended change

contracts.description: Contracts produced/consumed - APIs, DTOs, events, schemas shared with other tasks.

dependencies.description: Sequencing/dependencies - must run before/after which other chunk, if any.

acceptanceCriteriaCovered.description: Acceptance criteria covered - identifiers from above.

crossTaskIntegrationPoints.description: e.g. "React frontend consumes the `/employees` endpoint contract produced by the .NET backend chunk"

openQuestionsAndRisks.description: Anything that needs resolution before or during implementation
